member.name: T:RedisCachingApi.Controllers.ProductsController
member.summary: CRUD API for Products demonstrating Redis caching strategies. Each endpoint documents which caching strategy it exercises.

member.name: M:RedisCachingApi.Controllers.ProductsController.GetAll
member.summary: Get all products using Cache-Aside strategy. First call hits DB and populates Redis. Subsequent calls return cached data. Cache expires after 10 min (absolute) or 2 min of inactivity (sliding).

member.name: M:RedisCachingApi.Controllers.ProductsController.GetById(System.Int32)
member.summary: Get a single product by ID using Hybrid Caching (L1 MemoryCache → L2 Redis → DB).

member.name: M:RedisCachingApi.Controllers.ProductsController.Create(RedisCachingApi.DTOs.CreateProductDto)
member.summary: Create a new product using Write-Through strategy. Writes to DB and Redis synchronously, then broadcasts via SignalR.

member.name: M:RedisCachingApi.Controllers.ProductsController.CreateWriteBehind(RedisCachingApi.DTOs.CreateProductDto)
member.summary: Create a product using Write-Behind strategy. Updates Redis immediately; DB write is queued and processed asynchronously.
member.response: Product accepted and cached; DB write queued

member.name: M:RedisCachingApi.Controllers.ProductsController.Update(System.Int32,RedisCachingApi.DTOs.UpdateProductDto)
member.summary: Update a product using Write-Through strategy. Updates DB and Redis cache in a single synchronous operation.

member.name: M:RedisCachingApi.Controllers.ProductsController.Delete(System.Int32)
member.summary: Delete a product and remove it from all cache layers (Redis + MemoryCache).

member.name: T:RedisCachingApi.Data.InMemoryProductRepository
member.summary: Simulates a database using an in-memory store. In production this would be EF Core / SQL Server / etc.

member.name: T:RedisCachingApi.Hubs.ProductHub
member.summary: SignalR hub that pushes real-time product change events to all connected React clients. Events: ProductCreated, ProductUpdated, ProductDeleted.

member.name: T:RedisCachingApi.Services.ICacheService
member.summary: Abstraction over IDistributedCache with typed get/set helpers.

member.name: T:RedisCachingApi.Services.ProductService
member.summary: Demonstrates all five Redis caching strategies: Cache-Aside, Read-Through, Write-Through, Write-Behind, Hybrid (L1+L2).
